note: vespera-bridge fixes: the forwarded principal is also capped by bytes, so a user with many long authorities keeps the wire header within the Rust 1 MiB limit instead of getting 400 on every request (dropped entries are logged once); a HeaderSource callback that encodes another request on the same thread no longer corrupts the outer header; BufferTooSmallException.dispatched() tells the oversize-policy=throw rejection (nothing dispatched, requiredSize is the request size) from a response overflow; the unused byte[] ASYNC response builder is removed; the 413 for an unknown-length body over the built-in 64 MiB bound names that bound instead of a configured cap. Docs: a system property present at VesperaBridge.init fixes that native knob before Spring can override it; named-app CORS preflights reach the default app; client header values use the Latin-1 mapping; the native max-buffered-response-bytes default under Spring is 64 MiB; the Smart resolver splits on safe vs unsafe methods. Gradle plugin: native libraries are wired only into the main processResources, autoBuildCargo without cargoRoot fails with a clear message, nativeJarPlatforms without a source directory reports the intended error, and the cargo package lookup reads only package names. Demo tests: the shutdown probe timeout applies, mid-body panic cases follow the configured chunk size, and several assertions now check what they claim.
